Vietnam holiday 2023
Mar 2023 • Couples
Located on the first floor of the Pullman Hotel. A large restaurant with floor to ceiling windows that overlook the large foyer. It is open from 6am to 10pm. 6am to 10am for a buffet breakfast where they offer a verity of dishes, and eggs cooked to order. I just loved the Passion fruit juice and the passion fruit jam on my pancakes. The staff are amazing and very attentive.

They offer A La Carte for lunch and dinner with every now and then a buffet as well.

The restaurant has an open kitchen which adds that special touch to your dining.

Business set lunch - A big dissapointment
Mar 2022
I came to Pullman Hanoi to have lunch with my friend. We chose business set lunch expecting to have a quick and pleasant lunch. However, we had to wait for 40 minutes for the food to be served, which was quite surprising, given the fact that there were not many customers around at that time. The thing that bothers me so much is that the waiter did not inform me that it would take 40 minutes to prepare our food, leaving us wait hopelessly and cluelessly. For appetizer, we ordered veggie tempura and salad. The tempura was ok, even though it looks quite bland. On the other hand, the salad was not 5 star quality at all. The sauce is bland, the taste was not flavorful at all. For main course, we ordered medium steak, which turned out to be a big disppointment. The meat was a bit overcooked, thus the bite was hard and tough. The waiter was not attentive enough to help us change to steak knife so at first I had to cut the steak using regular knife, which is another minus for the experience. Lastly, for dessert, we ordered fruits and tiramisu. Fruits were alright but the tiramisu was the highlight of the whole set, even though it was a bit too sweet and too big of a portion.

Typical Hotel Restaurant & Good Breakfast Buffet
Apr 2019 • Solo
So I basically tried all three meals here in La Cheminee, which was named after the Cat Linh Chimney in front of the hotel. However, the food was not French, rather than a typical hotel coffee shop serving a mix of Western and Vietnamese food. For lunch and dinner, I just stuck with typical Vietnamese dishes because the Western dishes did not look too promising. The Hanoi Fried Rice was pretty good, but the Pho Ga (Chicken noodle soup) was a bit on the weak side. 

I also had breakfast buffet here at the restaurant too. It was surprisingly good with a good amount of typical Vietnamese and Western choices. There is an egg station, a great fruit and yogurt station, along with a Congee station, a Vietnamese hot food station, and a Noodle Station. I was very impressed with the breakfast offering. There were plenty of staffs but wish they could not be more proactive to refill tea and coffee. 

However, Pullman Hanoi needs a second full service restaurant serving a specific themed food. They need a Chinese, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean or Mediterranean restaurant.

Up to standard
Dec 2018 • Couples
We settled at this coffee shop on the first floor of Pullman hotel after a long day running around under big rain. Ordering hamburger is always a safe choice, my husband tried his luck with the rib eye steak - medium rare. But when the steak was here, it was like well done, with no pink or tenderness left. He sent it back and emphasized about the medium rare requirement, u should have known not many people speak English here, so we were a bit nervous about what we will get! After a long wait, we have a perfectly-cooked-medium-rare rib eye! It was a bit rare for a medium rare steak, but we were ok with it and found it very juicy and tasty. My hamburger was also up to standard, with a few interesting ingredients, pineapple, chorizo. We enjoyed it a lot.
